evidence.V1: Reads as a wall torch from front, 3/4 and silhouette (handle, cup, flame, back plate), but the top view is an unreadable orange blob and the flame reads more like a gem/crystal tip than fire at 64 px.
evidence.V2: Clear: handle and flame (big), cup and wall plate (medium), iron ring, gold cup lip (small).
evidence.V3: Handle, cup and plate are plain primitives; the flame is a stiff faceted cone with hard horizontal colour bands rather than a stylised licking flame shape.
evidence.V4: Wall plate and cup have soft chamfers, but the flame is hard-faceted with sharp creases while the handle is smooth, so edge treatment is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Stray faceting and lumpy creases across the flame, and the gold cup-lip band has a ragged, jagged top edge where it meets the flame (flame and cup close-ups, studio and flat).
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one flame hue in 2-3 values, wood handle, ink iron cup/plate/ring, gold lip; colourways swap only the flame.
evidence.V8: One LF_VertexColor material with ink iron and gold accents, but the crystal-faceted flame departs from the kit's smooth weighted-normal shading.
evidence.V9: Anchored, CanCollide off, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin back-centre for wall mounting; all gates pass (PointLight noted for placement).
